evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To bridge this gap, we introduce CyberPersistBench, the first benchmark dedicated to post-compromise installation and persistence.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Decoupled from upfront exploitation, CyberPersistBench frames persistence as an adversarial survival task in which agents use native host mechanisms to maintain footholds across staged system disruptions.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Deterministic checks support a six-level scoring method (L1--L6) spanning installation and persistence.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Empirical evaluations across five frontier agents show that autonomous persistence remains limited (27.6%--44.8%) and drops further on defense-enabled tasks (5.5%--13.3%); nonetheless, these results reveal an emerging cyberattack risk, underscoring the necessity of benchmarking post-compromise persistence.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: The benchmark comprises 203 core tasks across seven categories, augmented by multi-host and active defense extensions.
